info.title: AgentPorter API
info.description: AgentPorter Local Tools and Subagent Gateway for ChatGPT and MCP clients

get.description: List all configured workspaces with ID and status.
Return comprehensive development context for a workspace.

post.description: Run an explicitly permitted read-only diagnostic on Venkata through BCC SSH.
Transfer approved files into a new checksummed batch on Venkata; never overwrite.
Run one allowlisted SciNet diagnostic through Asgard's SSH master.
Stage the fixed Laya handoff into the approved SciNet directory.
Submit one approval-gated, one-GPU Laya job from a fixed template (full runs need private opt-in).
Read status only for a job submitted through this workspace.
Retrieve bounded outputs and result metadata for an approved job.

Fixed stage setup, setup status, read-only preflight, or environment check.

start runs only the SHA-verified staged login setup; it needs a pre-existing
authenticated session and never automates Duo or records approvals.
